description: Image bump PRs for home-config. Platform, endpoint and token are admin-only options and live in .forgejo/workflows/renovate.yaml. Setup and how to read a run: docs/renovate.md.
The kubernetes manager ships NO default file pattern: without managerFilePatterns it reports success and finds zero images. A run with a low dependency count means a pattern broke.

packageRules.description: One PR per app directory for its minor, patch and digest bumps. Majors stay one PR each.
linuxserver tags are v<upstream>-ls<build>. Without this the -ls suffix reads as a prerelease and no bump is proposed.
OrcaSlicer is pinned in apps/orcaslicer and apps/print-service and must move in one PR; the profile checks in apps/orcaslicer/README.md 'Updating' come before merging.
prBodyNotes: Before merging: apps/orcaslicer/README.md, Updating (profile inherits, print-service slice check, one GUI slice per process preset).

packageRules.description: Home Assistant ships breaking config changes in minor releases; review it on its own.
Immich server and machine-learning must move together.
An image on a floating tag (latest) gets a digest pin, so a new upstream push becomes a reviewable PR instead of a silent change on the next pod restart.
Our own images are pushed by their own CD pipelines; the tag here is a pointer, not a version to track. Last, so it wins over the rules above.
